diagnostics: The missing-fields baseline failed at the absent Subtitle control.

Initial owned-field attempts had a gesture that did not scroll the Form, then an incorrect duration accessibility identifier. Native swipe and the existing 60 minutes accessibility contract corrected those test issues.
The initial sole-link regression did not reveal the offscreen title. The corrected red run reached the title and failed on its stale value, then the same journey passed with the title refresh fix.
The first label journey overshot its picker with the keyboard open. The qualified journey selects labels before editing its title.

The expanded form made the existing reuse journey destination toggle require scrolling. The first full phone run passed six unaffected selected tests, plus two capture journeys, and failed that reuse journey at the hidden toggle. All three affected capture journeys were then rerun; only that complete green followup is used for their qualified outcomes. The outdated tablet run was intentionally interrupted before rerunning the corrected bundle.

The complete iPad run passed five unchanged regressions plus two field cases and failed two field cases at a collapsed sidebar and an unrendered lower field. The test helper now navigates through the sidebar, scrolls the native Form and reveals fields before waiting. All four affected field journeys were then rerun on both devices; only their complete green followups count toward qualification.
